text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] billing-meter: token-count-delta > 15% (EU region). Multiple customers flagged for overage. Probe: emitter -> ingest path. Paging sre-oncall and billing-ops. Please acknowledge and confirm impact scope.

sre-oncall: on it. acked. opening live-triage channel now. tagging @billing-ops and @eng-runtime. brief status?

billing-ops: seeing spike in deduped token counts between emitter and ledger. Customer-facing overage flags firing for ~42 accounts in eu-west-1. Delta appears concentrated in 12:00-12:18 UTC window. Investigating whether this is duplication or delayed batch replays.

eng-runtime: quick note — we had an emit_v2 rollout 2h ago that touched the emitter ack path. rolling hypothesis: duplicate ACKs causing emitter to resend tokens into ingest. pushing to reproduce.

sre-oncall: ok. mitigation suggestion: pause emit_v2 on EU region, and enable dedupe gate on ingest for incoming window. Who can flip the feature flag?

eng-runtime: i can toggle emit_v2 off in ~2 mins. command: ```/deploy feature-flag set emit_v2 eu-west-1 false --actor=eng-runtime``` then restart ingress proxy: ```kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/ingest-proxy-eu```

billing-ops: also starting a targeted reconciliation to mark suspected duplicates and suppress immediate overage notifications. running quick query to produce affected customer list. will share ids in a sec.

data-ingest: running streaming check now — consumer lag is low, but I see repeated message_ids for same session id in the 12:00-12:20 range. looks like replays from the emitter. I'll run a dedupe pass on the window: ```python tools/dedupe_window.py --start 2025-08-12T12:00Z --end 2025-08-12T12:20Z --mode=mark```

support-lead: heads up to customer success — prepare temporary credits & proactive outreach for customers impacted. don't post public notices yet until we confirm root cause. kate-cs, pls assemble top-20 affected customers for prioritization.

kate-cs: on it. compiling list now from billing-ops. will draft credit template after we know exposure.

billing-ops: preliminary list attached (sending offline). estimated delta ~+18% token count for affected customers in that window. auto-overage flags triggered by threshold rules. holding on to apply credits until dedupe run completes.

maria-p: if dedupe run confirms replays, please run the off-chain reconciler to avoid billing customers twice. command to run (ops only): ```/run-reconciler --window=2025-08-12T12:00Z,2025-08-12T12:20Z --mode=simulate``` then review result and flip to --apply.

sre-oncall: emit_v2 toggle completed by eng-runtime. ingress proxy restarted. monitoring metrics now.

incident-bot: status update: mitigation step 1 (emit_v2 rollback) completed at 1754209920. continue with dedupe + reconciler. severity: P2 until customer-facing overages confirmed.

eng-runtime: after rollback, duplicate message rate dropped to baseline within one minute. ingest dedupe caught ~11% of messages in the window. looks like partial duplication rather than full double-count.

billing-ops: reconciler simulate shows 95% of flagged tokens are duplicates. recommending apply and bulk credit for affected invoices. approving apply after support confirms messaging.

support-lead: approved. preparing email + credits. will delay outbound until credits applied.

incident-bot: final update: reconciler applied at 1754209980, credits queued for processing, overage notifications suppressed. closing live triage in 15m after monitoring. participants: sre-oncall, eng-runtime, billing-ops, data-ingest, support-lead, kate-cs, maria-p. :thumbsup:

sre-oncall: adding postmortem task to document emit_v2 rollout checklist and add automated smoke check for duplicate-acks in future deploys. will own action item.
